data.description: Why: Sources/Events/EventLog.swift rotates at an 8 MB cap and keeps one generation. Probe 1 run B found a spinner title in an unrelated workspace filled the backup in 65 minutes and erased the first six hours of the C11-188 run. Deliverable: (1) retention by age (default 14 days, configurable) with size as a secondary bound, several generations; (2) title and description change events coalesced when the same surface changes value more than N times per minute (emit first, last, and a count), so a spinner cannot flood the log; (3) log.rotated marker preserved; docs updated and synced; a test through the real EventLog that writes a churn burst and asserts retention. Out of scope: changing the envelope schema.
data.title: Event log retention by time with title-churn deduplication

provenance.reason: Probe 1 ingester spec, agentic-graph / Overwatch dialogue 2026-09-23; Lattice side is LAT-273..282

data.body: Evidence from a 5.5-day 0.67 production instance (2026-10-01 to 10-06, 1,208 tabs, 110 peak open): 54,882 events, 14.6 MB total, one rotation at about 2.6 days. Spinner OSC title frames were 9,090 of 15,441 metadata.changed (59%), the largest consumer of the budget. This run lost nothing only because it restarted before a second roll. 1.0 adds panel.input_sent with bodies up to 256 KiB, so retention pressure rises. Suggest tagging this c11-1.1. Related new tickets: C11-351 (self-describing panel.closed, so a short window still yields per-tab summaries) and C11-354 (c11 report).
